The Diary of Anne Frank — Act One
🔬 🧬
Homologous chromosomes
Two separate chromosomes — one from mom, one from dad. Same length & same genes, but maybe different alleles. They are split in Meiosis I.
🟥 + 🟦 → a PAIR
Sister chromatids
Two identical halves of ONE duplicated chromosome, joined at the centromere. They are split in Meiosis II.
🟥‖🟥 → twins of ONE
